name: RISEUP AT WORK
tagline: A subscription platform for post-hire career growth
description: RISEUP AT WORK is an AI-enabled career growth platform designed to support professionals in their post-hire journey. Grounded in over 20 years of coaching expertise, the platform provides tools for career longevity and progression. It currently serves a community of over 1,500 professionals through structured guidance and media-driven content.

founders.name: Dr. Deepak Bhootra
founders.bio: Sandler Certified Sales Coach and ICF Certified Coach with a Doctorate degree. Author of 6 books and host of RISEUP@work on NowMedia TV.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Officially launched the Wefunder campaign to scale our AI career tools.

highlights: Founded by 3x Amazon Best Selling author

name: Pelagion
tagline: A stand-up electric hydrofoil with steering capabilities
description: Pelagion, operated by Automatic Manufacturing Systems, Inc., is developing high-performance electric hydrofoils designed for stability and maneuverability. Leveraging decades of precision engineering experience, the company aims to redefine personal watercraft with eco-friendly technology. Their engineering pedigree includes providing solutions for top-tier companies like Tesla and SpaceX.

founders.name: Jamie P. Schlinkmann
founders.bio: Visionary leader behind PSLIM laboratory printers and AccuPlace assembly robots with extensive experience in robotics and automation.

updates.title: New Hydrofoil Prototype
updates.body: Advancing the steering capabilities of our latest electric hydrofoil model.

highlights: Engineering team has worked with SpaceX and Tesla
Over $8.9M in prior funding for manufacturing parent co

name: Lagom
tagline: Prefab homes to solve affordable housing
description: Lagom is a vertically integrated housing company focused on delivering factory-built, energy-efficient homes. By streamlining the manufacturing and development process, they aim to offer high-quality residential units at price points under $250,000. The company targets the growing demand for sustainable and affordable urban housing solutions.

founders.name: Skip Hulsey
founders.bio: 26 years of residential building and manufactured housing experience; currently an MRED candidate at Auburn University.

updates.title: Seed Round Opening
updates.body: Launched our Reg CF round to fund the first energy-efficient community.

highlights: Homes priced under $250K to ensure affordability
Founder has nearly 3 decades of construction expertise

name: EZPeazy, Inc
tagline: A service bidding platform to find local contractors
description: EZPeazy is a veteran-built marketplace that connects homeowners with local contractors through a transparent bidding system. The platform is designed to save homeowners money while helping contractors secure consistent work. It also features a unique youth work component to help teenagers earn money through local service tasks.

founders.name: Lance Smith
founders.bio: Veteran founder focused on creating efficient local service marketplaces and community earning opportunities.

updates.title: Expansion into Colorado Market
updates.body: Accelerating local contractor onboarding in the Thornton and Denver areas.

highlights: Dual-sided marketplace for contractors and homeowners

name: EAGLE CATHEDRAL CITY
tagline: Palm Springs’ premier leather bar and gay nightlife destination
description: Eagle Cathedral City is a dedicated hospitality venue serving the Coachella Valley's LGBTQ+ community. Reviving an iconic gay nightlife space, the venue combines community events, music, and a premium bar experience. The project has seen massive local support, exceeding initial funding targets through community-driven investment.

founders.name: Phillip Nalwalker
founders.bio: Experienced hospitality entrepreneur dedicated to creating safe and iconic spaces for the gay community in Palm Springs.

updates.title: Funding Milestone
updates.body: Surpassed $1.1M in community backing for the new Cathedral City location.

highlights: Premier leather bar concept in the Coachella Valley
